plan.chapterName: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, chapter 1: Prerequisites
plan.contextChunk: This figure is a plain black line drawing of a right circular cylinder viewed in perspective from slightly above. The top face is rendered as a complete ellipse; the bottom is a partial ellipse whose far arc is omitted, and the two are joined by straight vertical lines at the left and right silhouette edges, so the solid reads as opaque. A horizontal arrow begins at the center of the top ellipse and points to the right until it touches the rim, with the italic label r sitting just above its shaft. Outside the body of the cylinder, to the right, a vertical double-headed arrow reaches from the level of the top rim down to the level of the bottom rim and is labeled h. There is no shading, no coordinate frame, and no numerical scale anywhere in the drawing. The two arrows isolate the only two measurements the solid requires, one running across the circular cross-section and one running along the axis. The picture accompanies the surface-area formula S = 2 pi r (r + h), fixing which distance the symbol r stands for and which the symbol h stands for.

elements: Cylinder (opaque body with drawn edges for the rims and silhouette)
Radius arrow (horizontal line with arrowhead from the top face center to the right rim)
Radius label 'r' (above the radius arrow)
Height double-headed arrow (vertical, positioned slightly to the right of the cylinder)
Height label 'h' (next to the height arrow)
Surface area net: Top circular cap (hidden in 3D view)
Surface area net: Bottom circular cap (hidden in 3D view)
Surface area net: Rectangular lateral face (hidden in 3D view)

interactions.teaches: The object is a three-dimensional solid right circular cylinder.

interactions.label: Radius r
interactions.teaches: Increasing r widens the cylinder, which expands both the area of the circular caps and the circumference (width) of the lateral wrap.

interactions.label: Height h
interactions.teaches: Increasing h stretches the cylinder vertically, adding only to the lateral surface area without changing the size of the circular caps.

interactions.label: View Mode
interactions.teaches: Unrolling the cylinder reveals its surface area consists of two circular caps (total area 2πr²) and one rectangular lateral face (area 2πrh).

demo_steps.title: Cylinder Dimensions
demo_steps.narration: A right circular cylinder is defined by its radius r and height h. Adjust the sliders to see how they change the 3D shape.

demo_steps.title: Unroll to a Net
demo_steps.narration: Switch to the Surface Area Net. The cylinder unrolls into two circular caps and a rectangular lateral face.

demo_steps.title: Effect of Radius
demo_steps.narration: Increase the radius to 3. Notice that both the circular caps grow larger (πr²) AND the rectangle stretches wider (2πr), because the lateral face must wrap around the larger circumference.

demo_steps.title: Effect of Height
demo_steps.narration: Increase the height to 5. The rectangle grows taller, adding lateral area, but the circular caps remain exactly the same size.

interactionPlan.geometry_notes:
Base 3D Cylinder: positioned at origin, extending from y = -h/2 to y = h/2. Radius r arrow runs from (0, h/2, 0) to (r, h/2, 0). Height h arrow runs from (r + 0.5, h/2, 0) to (r + 0.5, -h/2, 0). Colors: white or very light gray solid fill (#ffffff to #f0f0f0) with black outlines (#000000) to match the line drawing aesthetic.
Net View: Unrolls flat onto the XY plane. Rectangle centered at origin with width 2*pi*r and height h. Top circle (radius r) centered at (0, h/2 + r, 0). Bottom circle (radius r) centered at (0, -h/2 - r, 0). In Net View, keep the 'h' arrow next to the rectangle and the 'r' arrow on one of the circular caps. Max dimensions are width 2*pi*3 approx 18.8, so scale camera appropriately to fit.
interactionPlan.notes: When toggling between 3D and Net views, crossfade the opacity of the 3D cylinder and the 2D net elements, or use a smooth unfolding animation if supported by the engine. Ensure labels 'r' and 'h' stay attached to their respective arrows and update their text positions reactively when sliders move.
